- Other candidates (Charcoal, Diplodia, Anthracnose, Purple Leaf Sheath) were clearly different visually.

The water-soaked, soft, tan-to-brown tissue at the lower internode with the plant still green is most consistent with Bacterial_Stalk_Rot.
